subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Companion default advance to a prerelease before an official artifact containing the required wizard-runtime correction is available and setup-proven?
rationale: The branch’s lifecycle changes may be valuable, but choosing a prerelease that fails the supported first-run path is a release-policy and user-support commitment that implementation review cannot safely make.

options.title: Wait for an official proven artifact
options.body: Keep the default unchanged until the upstream correction ships, then post redacted current-head setup/reconnect proof against that exact official package.

options.title: Sponsor a temporary prerelease default
options.body: Accept the known first-run wizard failure and support burden as an explicit temporary release policy, with clear rollback and user communication.

recommendation.title: Wait for an official proven artifact
recommendation.body: Keep the default unchanged until the upstream correction ships, then post redacted current-head setup/reconnect proof against that exact official package.

likelyOwner.reason: CassieMei is the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied setup and beta-alignment history, though the final release-policy choice needs a repository decision owner.
